scene: A worker receives a salary in a box with a fitted lid, while a painter weaves a picture of a meeting from thread.

tips.民: people: a small closed box on top, then the family-name sweep
tips.紙: paper: thread + family name (氏): starts with a slash, no closed box on top

scene: A crowd of people stands under a square banner, while a girl ties thread around a bundle of paper.

tips.母: mama: a frame with two dots and a line through it, nothing on top
tips.毎: every: mama with a banner top (a slash and a short line) on top

scene: A mama holds her baby, and every morning she wears a little cap with a feather on top.

tips.勉: exertion: excuse (免) with power (力) on the right
tips.晩: nightfall: sun (日) on the left of excuse

scene: A student shows exertion lifting weights, while at nightfall the sun sinks behind a man making an excuse.

tips.作: make: person (亻) on the left of the saw (乍)
tips.昨: yesterday: sun (日) on the left of the saw

scene: A person uses a saw to make a chair, while beside it the sun sets over the saw left out since yesterday.

tips.使: use: person + officer (吏): line, a plain mouth box, crossed legs
tips.便: convenience: person + grow late (更): line, a box with a line inside, crossed legs

scene: An officer shows a person how to use a tool, while another person enjoys the convenience of a late-night store.

tips.因: cause: a dog (大) inside the box
tips.困: quandary: a tree (木) inside the box

scene: A dog trapped in a box is the cause of the barking, while a tree stuck in another box faces a quandary about how to grow.

tips.五: five: a top line, a stem bending into a box shape, a flat base
tips.互: mutually: two hooks interlock between top and bottom lines, no stem

scene: Five fingers grip a box-shaped frame, while two hooks mutually interlock between two planks.

tips.子: child: a curved hooked body with one crossbar
tips.予: beforehand: a small loop (マ) on top replaces the child's curved head

scene: A child stands with arms out, while beside him a puppet with a looped head is prepared beforehand.

tips.無: nothingness: four oven-fire dots at the bottom
tips.舞: dance: the same top, but two dancing feet (舛) at the bottom instead of dots

scene: Over four burning embers there is nothingness, while beside them a pair of feet begins to dance.

tips.月: month: two inner lines, no stem through the middle
tips.用: utilize: month with a stem running down the middle through the lines

scene: A crescent moon marks the month, while a builder utilizes a pole driven straight through a moon-shaped frame.

tips.客: guest: each (各: walking legs over a mouth) under the roof
tips.容: contain: valley (谷: two pairs of slashes over a mouth) under the roof

scene: A guest walks into a house, while a second house has a valley inside that seems to contain a river.

tips.公: public: eight over an elbow (ム), a closed triangle

scene: A sword cuts a cake into parts, while in a public park a man rests his elbow on a triangular bench.

tips.元: beginning: two lines on top of human legs
tips.兄: elder brother: a mouth (口) on top of human legs
tips.見: see: an eye (目) on top of human legs

scene: At the beginning of a race, a runner stands with two lines on his shirt, his elder brother shouts with a wide mouth, and a giant eye on legs watches to see who wins.

tips.計: plot: say (言) + ten (十), a simple cross
tips.許: permit: say + noon (午), a slanted stroke over two lines

scene: A schemer counts ten fingers to plot a plan, while a guard at noon stamps a permit.
A child sits in a schoolhouse to study, while another student stares hard to see and memorize a lesson.

tips.都: metropolis: someone (者) beside the city walls (阝 on the right)
tips.部: section: muzzle (立 over 口) beside the city walls

scene: Someone stands proudly by the walls of a busy metropolis, while a muzzled dog guards one section of the wall.
A shopper uses a net to buy shells, a worker checks the placement of a net straightaway on a shelf, and a thief caught in a net looks un-happy with guilt.

tips.化: change: a person (亻) on the left, spoon (匕) on the right
tips.北: north: the left side is a stem with two ticks, two people back to back

scene: A person stirs with a spoon to change a potion, while two people sit back to back facing north.

tips.実: reality: roof over three lines and a pair of legs
tips.寒: cold: roof over a frame with extra posts, legs and two ice dots at the bottom

scene: Inside a cozy house reality sets in as a man stands warm, while next door a figure shivers in the cold beside two ice cubes.
